question: What signed money did one exactly identified FEC committee report receiving from another exactly identified FEC committee in one cycle, separated by the receipt's statutory role?

inputs.role: Every lossless processed Schedule A occurrence in one selected cycle, including exact raw and cleaned contributor IDs, receipt type, memo state, amount observation, and recipient committee ID.
inputs.version_policy: Pin the exact digest-verified Schedule A columnar fact-set manifest and its source-release ancestry.

identity.result_key: source committee ID + recipient committee ID + receipt role + FEC cycle + exact Schedule A fact-set identity + calculation version
identity.input_manifest: Exact Schedule A columnar fact-set ID, immutable manifest SHA-256, source release, physical schema, and every shard digest.
identity.result_digest: SHA-256 over canonical calculation identity fields and deterministic result keys.

ordered_steps: Require one complete, immutable, digest-verified processed Schedule A fact set for one cycle.
Classify every occurrence once in this order: valid normalization; valid recipient committee ID; source identity agreement; non-memo subtotal; exact reported amount; receipt-type role.
Accept a source identity only when contbr_id and clean_contbr_id are both exact C plus eight-digit IDs and are equal. Preserve one-sided and conflicting identities as unresolved exceptions.

Map exact receipt types to registered-filer contribution, registered-filer in-kind contribution, affiliated transfer in, refund or repayment received, outbound, semantic memo, earmarked, noncommittee receipt, or unresolved. Names, entity type, and is_individual are diagnostics and never override the receipt type.
Include only the four inbound roles. Keep in-kind separate from cash-like roles, retain signed negative and zero amounts, and never add Schedule B sender reports to the receiver-reported amount.
Group included occurrences by source committee ID, recipient committee ID, receipt role, and cycle. Publish exact signed minor units and positive, negative, and zero occurrence counts.
Publish the compact predicate, sparse unresolved exceptions, grouped results, source-shape diagnostics, and exact row and amount conservation totals.

decision_states.meaning: The processed occurrence failed source normalization and cannot enter a flow result.
The receiving filer is not an exact FEC committee ID.
Neither contributor identity field contains an exact FEC committee ID; this is not committee-to-committee flow.
Only the raw or cleaned contributor identity is an exact committee ID, so source identity is not corroborated.
Raw and cleaned contributor IDs are valid but disagree.
The publisher marks the occurrence as a memo subtotal that must not add another amount.
The candidate occurrence has no exact reported signed amount.
The Schedule A occurrence describes an outgoing or intermediary-out role, not money received from the identified contributor.
The receipt type is a semantic memo role even when the memo subtotal flag is absent.
The occurrence reports earmarked or conduit evidence and belongs to later source attribution, not a direct committee-flow edge.
The receipt type describes a noncommittee receipt and does not become committee flow merely because a contributor field resembles a committee ID.
The receipt type is absent or not mapped by this contract; no graph direction is inferred.
The receiver reported an exact signed amount from one corroborated committee source in an accepted inbound receipt role.

invariants: Schedule A is receiver-reported evidence. Schedule B is independent reconciliation evidence and never adds a second amount to the same flow calculation.
Every source occurrence has exactly one terminal decision. Decision order is semantic and versioned.
Raw and cleaned contributor IDs must agree exactly. Name matching, entity type, is_individual, and committee-master membership cannot manufacture a source ID.
Receipt-type role defines direction. A C-shaped contributor ID alone does not define committee flow.
In-kind contributions remain a separate receipt role so consumers can include or exclude them explicitly.
Earmarked records remain available for later conduit attribution and never become direct committee-flow edges here.
Negative and zero included amounts remain included. All arithmetic uses exact signed minor units.
Unknown receipt roles and unresolved identities remain measurable and queryable; the graph never silently coerces them into an edge.

output.grain: One compact membership manifest per exact Schedule A cycle fact set, one sparse exception per unresolved candidate occurrence, and one result per source committee, recipient committee, receipt role, and cycle.

publication_states.meaning: Every input occurrence was classified once and exact signed amounts conserve through grouped results and explicit non-result states.
Input identity, artifact bytes, decision membership, result grouping, or conservation failed verification.

revisions.input_change_policy: A changed Schedule A fact-set identity creates a new immutable calculation for only that cycle.
revisions.method_change_policy: Any change to decision order, source-ID agreement, receipt-code mapping, memo handling, amount membership, group key, or arithmetic requires a new calculation version.
revisions.history_policy: Retain every source fact, compact predicate, sparse exception, grouped result, source-shape profile, exact input identity, and superseded calculation manifest indefinitely.

checks.rule: The immutable manifest and every Parquet shard digest match one accepted Schedule A fact set and cycle.
Every Schedule A occurrence enters exactly one terminal decision.
Every known signed amount appears exactly once in included, excluded, or unresolved totals; included cents equal the sum of all results.
Every included occurrence contributes exactly once to one source-recipient-role result.
One-sided and conflicting contributor IDs are counted with exact signed money exposure.
Every exact-ID candidate occurrence is profiled by receipt type and description; unknown roles remain explicit.
Entity-type and is_individual disagreements are measured but never change routing.

scenarios: memo, outbound, semantic-memo, earmarked, and noncommittee exclusions

propagation.no_change_policy: An identical fact-set identity and calculation version reuse the immutable result. A changed cycle fact set recomputes only that cycle and downstream graph projections whose results or exceptions change.

use.retention: Retain exact Schedule A evidence outside the graph and publish grouped receiver-reported committee-flow components plus unresolved money and identity coverage.
use.disclaimer: These are amounts reported by receiving FEC filers. They are not personal payments to a candidate, do not prove influence or corruption, and do not by themselves establish that two differently named committees are the same organization.
